infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests camera access to show the prompt, and the Capture screen turns the camera on when you press Start camera.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests microphone access to show the prompt, the Speech screen listens when you press Listen, and the Capture screen records when you press Record.
infoPlist.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests permission to automate Finder to show the prompt.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests contacts access to show the prompt.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests calendar access to show the prompt.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests photo library access to show the prompt.
infoPlist.NSLocationUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests location access to show the prompt.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: The Privacy permissions screen requests location access to show the prompt.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: The Speech screen transcribes what you say when you press Listen.
